text: A person sees the consequences, gives exact consent, and gets a recovery path. The agent deletes the same account without four protections.
Same account. Same outcome: deleted. Visual: six of six. Assistive: six of six. Native Web M C P: two of six.
EqualTrace looks past the green final state. It finds the first break: the agent committed before consequences were disclosed, and links it to runtime evidence.
The agent can propose one bounded repair. It cannot approve it. A person reviews the exact action, consequence, seed, digest, and expiry.
That decision changes the native tool surface. Four tools become five. The repair runs once. Then five becomes four, and replay is blocked.
EqualTrace clears the old traces and reruns every route. All six protections survive. Five native runs produce the same deterministic receipt.
EqualTrace. The agent succeeded. The safety contract failed. Now every route gets the same protections. Provable.
